an8.119:1.1: “Bhikkhus, for direct knowledge of lust, eight things are to be developed.
an8.119:1.3: (1) One percipient of forms internally sees forms externally, limited, beautiful or ugly.
an8.119:1.4: Having overcome them, he is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’
an8.119:1.5: (2) One percipient of forms internally sees forms externally, measureless, beautiful or ugly. Having overcome them, he is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’
an8.119:1.6: (3) One not percipient of forms internally sees forms externally, limited, beautiful or ugly. Having overcome them, he is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’
an8.119:1.7: (4) One not percipient of forms internally sees forms externally, measureless, beautiful or ugly. Having overcome them, he is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’
an8.119:1.8: (5) One not percipient of forms internally sees forms externally, blue ones, blue in color, with a blue hue, with a blue tint … (6) … yellow ones, yellow in color, with a yellow hue, with a yellow tint …
an8.119:1.11: red in color, with a red hue, with a red tint … (8) … white ones, white in color, with a white hue, with a white tint.
an8.119:1.12: Having overcome them, he is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’
an8.119:1.13: For direct knowledge of lust, these eight things are to be developed.”
